# Foro3D

> > Spanish-language community exploring 3D modeling, additive manufacturing, game development pipelines, and emerging technologies at the intersection of digital art and engineering.

Foro3D covers technical analysis of 3D workflows across industries—from Blender architecture tools and Cinema 4D AI integration to biomedical prosthetics and cultural heritage digitization. The site bridges creative pipelines (character design, PBR workflows, game engines) with industrial applications (3D printing, digital twins, photogrammetry).

## Key Topics

- modelado 3D
- impresión 3D / fabricación aditiva
- análisis técnico de pipelines
- PBR y workflows híbridos
- fotogrametría y escaneo 3D
- diseño de personajes
- narrativa en videojuegos
- Blender y Cinema 4D
- motores de juego (Northlight, Unreal)
- gemelos digitales
- prótesis y robótica bioinspirada
- visualización científica 3D
- patrimonio cultural digital
- IA generativa en 3D
- hardware para workflows 3D
